create_Desc_subclass: create a subclass of Desc dataclass to bundle hyperparameters for a specific kind of job
implement_Desc_name_prefix: implement the name_prefix static method in a Desc subclass to return a run name prefix string
compute_Desc_hashname: compute the hashname property of a Desc instance to get a unique experiment storage name from hparams
implement_Desc_add_args: implement the add_args static method in a Desc subclass to register command-line arguments on an ArgumentParser
implement_Desc_create_from_args: implement the create_from_args static method in a Desc subclass to construct an instance from parsed CLI args
